structuredEvidence.definition: a descent ; as architecture, an ornamental appendage , perhaps a festoon

firstOccurrence.englishText: The men of Ai struck about thirty-six men of them. They chased them from before the gate even to Shebarim, and struck them at the descent. The hearts of the people melted, and became like water.

majorEvents.label: Death
majorEvents.evidenceText: As they fled from before Israel, while they were at the descent of Beth Horon, Yahweh hurled down great stones from the sky on them to Azekah, and they died. There were more who died from the hailstones than those whom the children of Israel killed with the sword.
